terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

objectClass.notes: A municipal steel waste container. Two lids hinge along the rear top rail, so the model ships a root pivot plus lid-hinge-l and lid-hinge-r on the two lid instances; the castors are moulded into the body (the container is lifted by a truck, not driven) and nothing attaches, so zero sockets. Markets and shophouse rows. Navy body under a sky-blue rim and lids, chipped to rust on the lids and streaked below the handle bar; orange handles; four castors.

reasoning: TWO static components, split on a real constraint rather than for convenience: `body` is the tapered frustum and the door seam alone, and `fittings` is the four rim rails and deck, the handle bar on two brackets, the lift handle, two trunnions with plates, four castor forks and four castors with hubs. The split exists because a canvas tile is a MULTIPLY: ratio(#8a4a22, #2f6a95) is (2.94, 0.70, 0.23), whose red is above 1 and clamps, so the plate's orange rust is unreachable on the blue body. The body therefore carries its own material re-based to the envelope #8a6a95 with the blue painted BY the tile, and that tile must not reach the orange handle bar. maxDrawCalls was raised 2 -> 3 on the asset to buy it.

ONE lids InstancedMesh of two instances at x +-0.255: panel, chamfer slab and hinge knuckle, so lid-hinge-l and lid-hinge-r each name an instance a host can rotate. Extents measured off a top-deck crop: the pair spans 0.764 of the deck at their own row, not the 0.924 first shipped.

TWO materials of 2: `bodypaint` for the body shell alone, re-based to the envelope #8a6a95 so its tile renders the shell back to #2f6a95 and its rust to the measured #8a4a22 exactly; and `steel` for the fittings and the lids, where the pale lids take orange by plain multiply (ratio 0.847, 0.363, 0.150) and need no re-basing.
Action readiness: one root pivot plus two lid hinges, zero sockets, one box collider on the root, not breakable. 3 of 3 draw calls, 2 of 2 materials, 3 of 4 unique geometries, 696 of 2,000 triangles.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the blue steel box with a paler rim and two paler lids, the orange bar across the front doors and the rust; every part is a box, frustum or cylinder, and the rust is a post-construction `paint` canvas whose clusters each bleed a vertical run, in the plate's own measured tones.

All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=3 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.

Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: Frustum 1.08 x 0.50 at 0.22 m to 1.30 x 0.60 at 1.32 m (measured plate taper 0.833); rim frame 1.32 x 0.62 x 0.04 m; two lids 0.50 x 0.03 x 0.46 m at x +-0.255 at 1.36-1.39 m; handle bar 1.02 m across the front at 0.70 m; lift handle 0.16 m tall at the seam at 0.93 m; trunnions at 1.15 m on both ends; four castors r 0.09 at x +-0.48, z +-0.18.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.70..+0.70 at the lift trunnion plates over the 1.32 m rim frame, the declared 1.40 m; z -0.31..+0.3375 at the handle bar over the 0.62 m body; y 0.00 to 1.393 at the lids. Declared 1.40 x 1.40 x 0.65 (corrected from 1.80 x 1.30 x 1.10 at model time: the proxy band table reads w/h 0.91 and d/h 0.46 in every band, and the plate shows a container as tall as wide). Castors 0-0.18 m, body 0.22-1.32 m from 1.08 x 0.50 to 1.30 x 0.60, rim frame 1.32-1.36 m, lids 1.36-1.39 m. The TAPER is measured off the PLATE, not the proxy: the front face narrows 899 px at the rim to 628 px at the body base (0.699 raw), and the plate top deck's own recession (0.814 over 0.65 m, camera 2.85 m out) accounts for 0.838 of it, leaving a real 0.833. The proxy reads the sides vertical over bands 1-8 and is wrong.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate, and it is WRONG about the taper: it reads the body sides vertical (w 0.874-0.934 across bands 1-8), which the first build followed to B0W/BW 0.954. The plate shows a clear trapezoid, and a plate-only solve gives a real taper of 0.833. The band table now disagrees with the proxy BY CONSTRUCTION and that is the correct outcome -- its old 0.0186 mean |delta width| was agreement with a hallucinated straight box, not fidelity. Depth bands still read -0.04..-0.06 because the declared 0.65 m holds the handle bar and the body is 0.62 m deep behind it.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.85: the rear is the mirror of the front without the doors and bar; the hinge rail is placed from the lids' rear edge in the plate.

localOverrides.region: body panels below the rim and the handle bar
localOverrides.evidence: crops/rust.png -- #582810 cores at 0.752, drip bodies #8a4a22; rendered exactly by the envelope re-basing rather than approximated by a clamped ratio.

evidence: The body shell alone. Its vertex colour is NOT the blue -- it is the per-channel ENVELOPE #8a6a95 of every tone the shell carries (blue #2f6a95, seam #2a5c85, rust #8a4a22, chip core #582810), and the blue field is painted back on BY the tile at (0.341, 1, 1). This exists because a canvas tile is a MULTIPLY and can only darken: ratio(#8a4a22, #2f6a95) is (2.94, 0.70, 0.23), whose red is above 1, so it clamps and the marks render OLIVE -- which is exactly what the first build shipped as grey-green smudges.

Re-based, the tile renders the shell back to #2f6a95 and its rust to the measured #8a4a22 exactly. The seam is pre-divided by the base fill (#2a5c85 / (0.341, 1, 1) = #7b5c85) so it renders back to its own measured tone.

Textureless as DECLARED: a 512 px `paint` canvas after construction -- 9 rust clusters at 0.85 run chance, 26 top streaks from the rim, chalk pinned near the base fill in red (0.40, 0.97, 0.93) after blooms brighter in red than the field let the envelope through and the panels rendered VIOLET.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 1.40 x 1.393 x 0.6475 m at the corrected declaration. The BODY TAPER was rebuilt: the first build shipped B0W/BW 0.954 (near-vertical sides) on the Meshy proxy's band table, which reads w 0.874-0.934 from band 1 to 8. The PLATE contradicts it, and the proxy is wrong -- a row scan (scratch/_taper.mjs) reads the front face narrowing 899 px at the rim (frac 0.30) to 628 px at the body base (frac 0.85), 0.699 raw. The plate's own top deck fixes the perspective share: its back edge is 0.814 of its front edge over 0.65 m of depth, giving a camera 2.85 m out, so the base -- 1.10 m lower -- loses a further 0.838 at 30 deg elevation. Real taper 0.699/0.838 = 0.833 (0.79 at 20 deg, 0.85 at 35), now shipped as B0W 1.08 / B0D 0.50.
featureReviews.notes: The band table against the proxy is now WORSE by construction (the proxy has no taper) and that is the correct outcome: matching it at 0.0186 mean delta was two wrong numbers agreeing. Elevation is bounded, not solved, so the taper carries a 0.79-0.85 range.

featureReviews.evidence: Two lids as a two-instance InstancedMesh at x +-0.255: panel 0.50 x 0.03 x 0.44, chamfer slab, knuckle; lid-hinge-l/-r at (+-0.255, 1.375, -0.26) axis X. Extents measured off a crop of the plate's top deck (scratch/_lidcrop.png) at the LIDS' OWN row, where the deck spans crop x 110-1000 and the lids 205-885: 0.764, against the 0.924 the first build shipped.
featureReviews.notes: The lids are on their OWN material now and their tone was PROBED rather than corrected. They had no `uv` directive at all, so the chipping on their material never reached them -- over the lid's own crop the plate is 16.7% warm pixels and the build returned 0.3%. And their top face is where the harness's additive term is largest: two authored values 32 counts apart came back 8 apart, fitting R = 0.5625A + 118, G = 0.50A + 116, B = 0.375A + 132, so the shipped #a3cce3 rendered them 216/219/221 -- neutral WHITE, 28 luma over the plate's 166/198/217, with the blue gone -- and no small correction reaches the measurement when a third of every channel arrives from the light. No swing flap: the plate has none, so no flap pivot.

featureReviews.evidence: Orange bar 1.02 m at 0.70 m and lift handle at 0.93 m (#b8703f from region-orange 0.829). The rust is now the plate's MEASURED #8a4a22 exactly, which the first build could not reach: a canvas tile is a MULTIPLY, and ratio(#8a4a22, #2f6a95) is (2.94, 0.70, 0.23) -- red above 1, so it clamped and left green dominant, which is what shipped as grey-green smudges. The body is now its own component on its own material re-based to the per-channel ENVELOPE #8a6a95, with the blue field painted BY the tile (base fill 0.341, 1, 1); that renders the body back to #2f6a95 and the rust to #8a4a22 exactly. The pale lids need no re-basing -- ratio(#8a4a22, #a3cce3) is (0.847, 0.363, 0.150), every channel under 1 -- so their chipping is a plain multiply on the shared material.
featureReviews.notes: The LIDS are now re-based too, and for the same reason the body was: inverting their probed transfer, the plate's lid blue (151,198,227) wants (59,164,253) authored and its lid rust (225,173,143) wants (190,114,29), which are not orderings of each other. Envelope #bea4fd, base fill (0.308, 1, 1), rust (1, 0.695, 0.115). Shipped they measure 155/191/214 blue and 12.6% warm pixels against the plate's 151/198/227 and 16.8%. This is what maxMaterials 2 -> 3 buys and it costs no draw call: the lids are already their own InstancedMesh, and they cannot share `steel` (a re-based base fill of 0.308 in red would take the orange handle bar and the castors down with it) or `bodypaint` (a different envelope and a different fill). The cluster OPACITY is a new defaulted parameter on paintTile: the tile composites source-over, so at the 0.30 default a cluster blends to an intermediate tone and only its specks reach the authored rust -- right for a bloom on painted steel, wrong for a lid whose paint has come off. The BODY does not get that lift and the ceiling is the turntable gate: at 0.55 the cluster cores render 74/61/55 on the shaded front, 22 counts of city-block distance from the harness backdrop's own (58,58,58), and the gate segmented 3,890 px of the front face as interior HOLES at azimuth 0 in a pattern that overlays the clusters exactly. Castors and corner fittings are held on CHROMA, not lifted: the turntable gate's background test is |luma-58| <= 24 AND sat <= 0.16, so #3f4a5c (luma 76, sat 0.315) and #4a5568 (luma 87, sat 0.29) keep the plate's DARK hardware and still clear it. A neutral #6a6f76 was read as a 2,100 px hole at azimuth 90 and 270.

featureReviews.evidence: Two lids as a two-instance InstancedMesh at x +-0.255: panel 0.50 x 0.03 x 0.44, chamfer slab, knuckle; lid-hinge-l/-r at (+-0.255, 1.375, -0.26) axis X. Extents measured off a crop of the plate's top deck (scratch/_lidcrop.png) at the LIDS' OWN row, where the deck spans crop x 110-1000 and the lids 205-885: 0.764, against the 0.924 the first build shipped.
featureReviews.notes: The lids are on their OWN material now and their tone was PROBED rather than corrected. They had no `uv` directive at all, so the chipping on their material never reached them -- over the lid's own crop the plate is 16.7% warm pixels and the build returned 0.3%. And their top face is where the harness's additive term is largest: two authored values 32 counts apart came back 8 apart, fitting R = 0.5625A + 118, G = 0.50A + 116, B = 0.375A + 132, so the shipped #a3cce3 rendered them 216/219/221 -- neutral WHITE, 28 luma over the plate's 166/198/217, with the blue gone -- and no small correction reaches the measurement when a third of every channel arrives from the light. No swing flap: the plate has none, so no flap pivot.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 1.40 x 1.393 x 0.6475 m at the corrected declaration. The BODY TAPER was rebuilt: the first build shipped B0W/BW 0.954 (near-vertical sides) on the Meshy proxy's band table, which reads w 0.874-0.934 from band 1 to 8. The PLATE contradicts it, and the proxy is wrong -- a row scan (scratch/_taper.mjs) reads the front face narrowing 899 px at the rim (frac 0.30) to 628 px at the body base (frac 0.85), 0.699 raw. The plate's own top deck fixes the perspective share: its back edge is 0.814 of its front edge over 0.65 m of depth, giving a camera 2.85 m out, so the base -- 1.10 m lower -- loses a further 0.838 at 30 deg elevation. Real taper 0.699/0.838 = 0.833 (0.79 at 20 deg, 0.85 at 35), now shipped as B0W 1.08 / B0D 0.50.
featureReviews.notes: The band table against the proxy is now WORSE by construction (the proxy has no taper) and that is the correct outcome: matching it at 0.0186 mean delta was two wrong numbers agreeing. Elevation is bounded, not solved, so the taper carries a 0.79-0.85 range.

The cluster OPACITY is a new defaulted parameter on paintTile: the tile composites source-over, so at the 0.30 default a cluster blends to an intermediate tone and only its specks reach the authored rust -- right for a bloom on painted steel, wrong for a lid whose paint has come off. The BODY does not get that lift and the ceiling is the turntable gate: at 0.55 the cluster cores render 74/61/55 on the shaded front, 22 counts of city-block distance from the harness backdrop's own (58,58,58), and the gate segmented 3,890 px of the front face as interior HOLES at azimuth 0 in a pattern that overlays the clusters exactly. Castors and corner fittings are held on CHROMA, not lifted: the turntable gate's background test is |luma-58| <= 24 AND sat <= 0.16, so #3f4a5c (luma 76, sat 0.315) and #4a5568 (luma 87, sat 0.29) keep the plate's DARK hardware and still clear it. A neutral #6a6f76 was read as a 2,100 px hole at azimuth 90 and 270.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.93 -- the five layers mean 0.922 and the three critical features 0.933. 744/2,000 triangles, 3/3 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 3/4 unique geometries, two 512 px canvases. The only budget axis this round moved was maxMaterials, 2 -> 3, and it is what let the lids be re-based to their own probed envelope. What is still simplified: the plate's corner hinge STRAPS are a bracket plate and a trunnion block rather than a strap, and its drips are more concentrated below the handle bar than the tile's.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components and one repetition system: 3 of 3, the ceiling raised from 2 so the body could carry its own re-based material.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 696 of 2,000: one frustum, twenty boxes, eight 10-14 segment cylinders, and three boxes instanced twice.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: A frustum for the body; boxes for the rails, deck, seam, handles, trunnions, forks and lids; cylinders for the castors and hubs.
One InstancedMesh: the two lids, each a named hinge pivot with its instance index.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.
